claim: Shell: executable split create inserts at index, reuses already-open non-component entities, removal replaces last empty split with default, reorder swaps adjacent split state. No backend collaboration assertion.
Shell: each split has executable navigation-history back/forward operations with capture and apply of entry state.
Shell: scoped keyboard close/back-to-list, spotlight, history back/forward and adjacent split focus; conditions and handlers are registered.

Shell: route definitions include drive/settings/agents/home/recent/activity/reminders/email/tasks/reviews/calendar/channels/calls/companies/search/PR and legacy routes; registration proves navigation availability, not feature completeness.
PDF block passes document version/proxy/modification data and canComment/canEdit/owner permissions to PdfDocument, with sidepanel and tabs.
PDF shared message comment path creates anchored root for highlight/free placeable or replies to an existing root, then activates returned created message.
PDF definition lookup parses precomputed XML terms including definition/page/position/reference data and returns cloned terms; not evidence of general live dictionary API.
PDF viewer downloads PDF with modifications/comments; Download DOCX is exposed only when underlying fileType is docx. Does not establish arbitrary PDF-to-DOCX export.
Conversion queue processing calls convert and handles DOCX conversion success/failure notifications; separate worker path, not proof of PDF-to-DOCX export.
Image viewer renders loaded document Blob in ImageContent and file sidepanel; cmd-copy emits document entity ref.
Image content derives object URL from Blob for native img preview and cleanup; source entry for media preview only.
Video viewer renders native video controls/autoplay for available URL and reports unsupported/error playback; no transcoding or shared playback assertion.
Unified notification source executes bulk done and seen mutations with persistent optimistic overrides and rollback on failure; empty batches skipped.
Message notification marker matches exact messageId/commentId among parent notifications and bulk marks all unseen; max three attempts per mount. TODO warns current parent scope is thread-aware.
Snooze UI belongs to notifications and delegates chosen deadline via onSelect; pending guards repeat selection. UI text alone does not establish scheduler execution.
My activity uses ActivityContext/state with virtualized rows, pinned date, pagination and caller onOpen entity callback.
Per-entity activity is rollout-flag gated (no query while disabled), keyed by entity type/id, has loading/error/empty states and folded timeline.
Activity domain executes bounded subject activity read and resolves distinct property display metadata through viewer-scoped resolver; this file does not establish all entity event writers.
Favorites UI opens canonical split content current/new/fullscreen and invokes remove-favorite mutation keyed entity type/id.
Favorites domain adds via authenticated View receipt, lists/removes per user, validates reorder length and uniqueness before persistence port call.
Contextual share entry validates supported entity type and opens shared modal outside block; passes OWNER UI permission assumption, which is not authoritative server authorization.

Mention-driven share inserts direct entity_access for mentioned users on PUBLIC or TEAM link without filtering team membership, never downgrades existing grants. This security-sensitive behavior is not ROX target default.
Legacy AI Chat block reads chat data and marks chat entity notifications, composes Chat plus sidepanel; distinct from human MessageParent.
AI chat sends optimistic user message, invokes send command, records send failure or attaches returned stream; stop calls cognition stopChatStream. Domain tool authorization is elsewhere.
Agent composer chooses repository/branch for coder context, explicit repo accepted only Cursor harness, blocks unavailable agents/pending uploads, emits onStart with persona/model/effort/attachments.
Coding/chat agent surface starts pending session using userId then opens agent_session context. This entry does not prove server provisioning or rerun semantics.
Coding session displays repository/branch and PR status open/draft/merged/closed, with internal callback or GitHub link; not write/review submission.

PR detail queries foreign entity, displays title/metadata/description and GitHub comment timeline. Local Macro discussion is explicitly prototype-only and lost on reload; no diff renderer in this path.
PR timeline merges GitHub issue/review comments and review summaries into ordered threaded timeline; review-comment replies use GitHub single-level thread semantics.
Skill read permits built-in system skills directly, otherwise authorizes document and verifies nondeleted Markdown Skill subtype; search/list merge domain results with static system skills.
Agent read_skill tool delegates skill service with authenticated context user; supports full skill content. Not standalone activation engine.
Frontend creates Markdown Skill via storage createSkill command then previews canonical document subtype skill and refreshes Soup; exact creation source lies outside crates/skills root.
Automation editor loads schedules, selects by id, validates prompt/frequency/time, autosaves update mutation using current cron schedule; not evidence of arbitrary event DSL.
Automation run history renders up to 50 passed records with loading/no-runs states; persistence established by scheduled action service separately.
Scheduler validates target and event management, persists owner/config revision/next run then dispatches create; owned enable/delete/manual execution and persisted history queries exist.
Scheduler has Cron timezone and Events filters; closed allowlist currently document.created/updated and five channel event variants. New broker event does not automatically enable a routine.
Scheduled ActionKind currently only Agent; task carries prompt/user_prompt and optional model/agent persona. Do not claim generic notify/reminder task kind from this schema.
Event management defaults off in scheduled action constructor and must be explicitly enabled by service composition. Event model presence does not prove all deployments expose event-trigger routines.
